spec_dod.text: A config file with every required key present, including `cache_ttl`, validates cleanly under `confcheck config validate` and exits 0.
A config file missing the required `log_level` key fails validation and names `log_level` specifically in the error.
A config file with an out-of-range value for `cache_ttl` (e.g. a negative timeout) is rejected, not silently clamped.
Validating a config file never mutates the file on disk — a byte-for-byte diff of the file before and after `config validate` is empty.

confcheck config validate (cache_ttl=-5, out of range)
